name: Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, and commercialization of fluid machinery and compressor systems. Their extensive product line includes industrial fans, various air compressors (such as centrifugal and hydrogen fuel cell models), small-scale steam turbines, industrial boilers, slurry ice production units, and supercritical carbon dioxide (CO2) expanders. Furthermore, the company provides integrated system solutions for diverse applications, including air system modernization, pressure air stations, biomass gasification for cogeneration, waste heat and gas recovery for energy, thermal and cold energy storage, solar thermal power islands, hydrogen-based distributed energy, seawater ice-making, combined pressure power and ice generation, compressed air energy storage for electricity, geothermal power plants, and supercritical CO2 power generation. Founded in Nantong, China, in 1993, the company changed its name to Jin Tong Ling Technology Group Co., Ltd. in August 2019, formerly known as JiangSu Jin Tong Ling Fluid Machinery Technology Co., Ltd.
